nodes.description: Public total supply state variable declared in the ERC20 base contract; set once in the SMN1 constructor.
Owner address of the contract, initialized from msg.sender and mutable only through transferOwnership.
Mapping of account balances mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the SMN1 constructor.
Nested mapping of allowance approvals keyed by owner and spender.
Boolean switch controlling whether transfers are allowed, toggled by the owner.
Token name string 'Super Module Network One'.
Token symbol string 'SMN1'.
Token decimals set to 18.
Maximum supply cap computed with exponentiation arithmetic from decimals.
Library multiplication routine with assertion on overflow.
Library addition routine with assertion on overflow.
Library subtraction routine with assertion on underflow.
Constructor that assigns ownership to the deploying caller.
Owner-only function that replaces the owner address with an arbitrary _owner value.
Owner-only function toggling the transferable flag that gates all token transfers.
Public transfer function moving _value tokens from msg.sender to _to under the canTransfer modifier.
Public transferFrom moving tokens using an allowance, updating balances and allowed mapping.
Public approval function writing an allowance for _spender from msg.sender.
View function returning the remaining allowance between owner and spender.
Token constructor minting the total supply cap to the issuer address.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting raw ether transfers.
Caller address supplied by msg.sender when the Owned constructor runs.
Caller address supplied by msg.sender in ERC20Token.transfer.
Caller address supplied by msg.sender in ERC20Token.transferFrom.
Caller address supplied by msg.sender in ERC20Token.approve.
Privileged state write that overwrites the owner variable with a caller-supplied address.
Privileged state write that flips the transferable flag, enabling or blocking all transfers.
Balance arithmetic that deducts _value from balances[msg.sender].
Balance arithmetic that credits _value to balances[_to].
Balance arithmetic that deducts _value from balances[_from].
Balance arithmetic that credits _value to balances[_to].
State write that sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] to _value, with a revert-based race guard.
Constructor mint assigning the whole supply cap to totalSupply and balances[_issuer].
Recipient address parameter of ERC20Token.transfer.
Token amount parameter of ERC20Token.transfer.
Source address parameter of ERC20Token.transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of ERC20Token.transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of ERC20Token.transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of ERC20Token.approve.
Allowance amount parameter of ERC20Token.approve.
Boolean flag parameter of ERC20Token.setTransferable.
New owner address parameter of Owned.transferOwnership.
Issuer address parameter of the SMN1 constructor receiving the initial supply.

edges.reason: The Owned constructor writes the untrusted deployer address into the owner state variable.
msg.sender becomes the owner, so the privilege value originates from the caller.
The onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership compares msg.sender against owner.
The onlyOwner modifier on setTransferable authorizes the call based on msg.sender.
transferOwnership performs the privileged owner overwrite operation.
The owner state variable is replaced with the caller-supplied address.
The _owner parameter flows directly into the owner assignment.
setTransferable executes the privileged transferable flag write.
The transferable state variable is written by the owner-only operation.
The _transferable parameter value is stored into the transferable flag.
msg.sender is the calling account executing transfer.
The balances mapping is indexed and updated with msg.sender as key.
transfer executes the balance deduction of _value from the sender.
transfer executes the balance credit of _value to the recipient.
transfer delegates balance subtraction to SafeMath.sub.
transfer delegates balance addition to SafeMath.add.
The sender balance entry is reduced by the arithmetic operation.
The recipient balance entry is increased by the arithmetic operation.
The _value parameter is the amount deducted from the sender balance.
The _value parameter is the amount credited to the recipient balance.
The _to parameter is the destination key for the credited balance.
msg.sender is the calling account executing transferFrom.
The allowed mapping is indexed with msg.sender as the spender key.
transferFrom executes the balance deduction from the _from account.
transferFrom executes the balance credit to the _to account.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance subtraction to SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom delegates balance addition to SafeMath.add.
transferFrom decrements the stored allowance in the allowed mapping.
balances[_from] is reduced by the arithmetic operation.
balances[_to] is increased by the arithmetic operation.
The _value parameter is the amount deducted from the source balance.
The _value parameter is the amount credited to the destination balance.
The _from parameter is the source key for the balance deduction.
The _to parameter is the destination key for the balance credit.
msg.sender is the calling account executing approve.
The allowed mapping is keyed by msg.sender as the approval owner.
approve performs the allowance state write operation.
The allowed mapping entry is set to the approved amount.
The _spender parameter selects the allowance mapping key.
The _value parameter is the allowance amount granted to the spender.
The SMN1 constructor performs the initial supply mint operation.
totalSupply is initialized to the computed supply cap.
The entire supply cap is credited to balances[_issuer].
The _issuer parameter receives the minted initial supply.
The constructor reads totalSupplyCap as the minted amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to key the balance credit performed by the transfer addition operation.
The _value parameter is consumed by the sender balance deduction operation.
The _from parameter is the source key used by the balance deduction operation.
The _to parameter is the destination key used by the balance credit operation.
The _value parameter is consumed by the balance and allowance subtraction operation.
The _spender parameter is used only as the key of the allowance write operation.
The _value parameter is the amount stored by the allowance write operation.
The _transferable parameter flows directly into the transferable flag write operation.
The _owner parameter flows directly into the privileged owner write operation.
The _issuer parameter is the recipient of the initial supply mint operation.
